<noinclude>
== Usage ==
<pre>
{{Avatarian|k uh t ah r uh|Katara}}
</pre>

The first parameter is the word spelled in '''sounds''' — the same
readable codes the translator's "Sounds" box takes: <code>k uh t ah r
uh</code> is ''Katara'' (ARPAbet in CAPITALS and raw IPA both work too).
The second parameter is the English '''label''' shown on hover. This
draws '''exactly''' the spelling you give.

Hovering the glyphs shows the label and the IPA, e.g. ''Katara /k ə t ɑ r ə/''.

To get the sounds for a word, type it into the
[https://REPLACE-ME translator] and copy what appears in its "Sounds" box.
The sound-code table is in that tool's "How to write sounds" panel, and in
<code>AVATARIAN.md</code> §10 in the project repo.

This template does not draw anything by itself. It just marks the text; a
script loaded from [[MediaWiki:Common.js]] finds every
<code>.avatarian-word</code> span after the page loads and replaces it
with the real glyphs. With JavaScript off, the plain label (or the sounds)
is shown instead of a blank.
</noinclude><includeonly><span class="avatarian-word" data-avatarian-sounds="{{{1|}}}" data-avatarian-label="{{{2|}}}">{{{2|{{{1|}}}}}}</span></includeonly>
